caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cradle with a rectangular body and curved ends. The cradle is reddish-brown in color, suggesting it is made out of stained wood. It stands on two curved, outward-splayed legs that support its structure. The headboard and footboard both rise above the sides, with the headboard having an ornate, wavy outline and the footboard being less pronounced but still rounded. The overall background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color, providing contrast to the cradle and making it the central focus. The grain of the wood and construction details, such as joints at the corners, are visible in the depiction.
title: Doll Cradle
